label: common_2020_mizu_010_mizu_01
text: Heya! Step right up! Welcome to the\nCascarrafa Gym![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: common_2020_mizu_010_mizu_02
text: Vaultin’ Veluza! Look who it is! I was expectin’\nsomeone else![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: common_2020_mizu_010_mizu_03
text: Aha! I see! Ms. Geeta put you up to this, did she?[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: common_2020_mizu_010_mizu_04
text: It feels like just yesterday that you were out\ncollectin’ yer badges, and now look at ya—\r\nalready Champion Rank![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: common_2020_mizu_010_mizu_05
text: You’re like one o’ those fish Pokémon that\ncompletely changes shape and name as it\r\nevolves! All full o’ life. What a great catch![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: common_2020_mizu_010_mizu_06
text: And now this! Our promising up-and-comer, here\nto test my abilities h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imerself![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: common_2020_mizu_010_mizu_07
text: Don’t worry—this ol’ man’s used to facin’ harsh\nreviewers. Part o’ the restaurant business.[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: common_2020_mizu_010_mizu_08
text: All righty, then. You ready to battle this ol’ man\nand see if he’s still fit to be called Gym Leader?[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: common_2020_mizu_010_mizu_retry
text: Heya! Step right up! How ’bout it? You ready to\nbattle this ol’ man?[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: common_2020_mizu_010_mizu_09
text: That’s what I like to hear! Right this way![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: common_2020_mizu_010_mizu_10
text: Whether it’s gettin’ the freshest ingredients or\nthe best battle—timin’ is everything! Come back\r\nbefore too long, ya hear?[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
